metadata.question: Are there active fires in October 24, 2023 in Canada?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Active Fire (MCD64A1), FIRMS active-fire MODIS or VIIRS active-fire (VNP14IMGTDL_NRT) - Recent date 2023-10-24 (Canada wide). 2. Masking: We look for ACTIVE pixels, no cloud mask required. 3. Logic: If images found and >0 valid ACTIVE pixels, answer A; 0 pixels → B; 0 images for that day → C1; empty result → C2/C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Full Canada rough outline canada = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[-141, 60], [-50, 60], [-50, 50], [-141, 50], [-141, 60]]) # 2. FIRMS VIIRS Near-Real-Time active fires collection fires = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/VNP14IMGTDL_NRT')\ .filterDate('2023-10-24', '2023-10-25')\ .filterBounds(canada) if fires.size().getInfo() == 0: print("C1: No fire images for 2023-10-24") print("C1") else: # Active fire mask (confidence >= 30) active = fires.select('MaxFRP').map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('Confidence').gte(30))) mosaic = active.mosaic() # Count pixels to detect C2 pixCount = mosaic.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=canada, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('MaxFRP') if ee.Algorithms.IsValid(pixCount).Not().getInfo() or pixCount.getInfo() is None: print("C3: Null after processing") print("C3") else: c = int(pixCount.getInfo()) print(f"Active pixels on 2023-10-24: {c}") print("A" if c > 0 else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Full Canada rough outline
canada = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[-141, 60], [-50, 60], [-50, 50], [-141, 50], [-141, 60]])

# 2. FIRMS VIIRS Near-Real-Time active fires collection
fires = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/VNP14IMGTDL_NRT')\
            .filterDate('2023-10-24', '2023-10-25')\
            .filterBounds(canada)
if fires.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("C1: No fire images for 2023-10-24")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Active fire mask (confidence >= 30)
    active = fires.select('MaxFRP').map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('Confidence').gte(30)))
    mosaic = active.mosaic()
    # Count pixels to detect C2
    pixCount = mosaic.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                   geometry=canada,
                                   scale=1000,
                                   maxPixels=1e9).get('MaxFRP')
    if ee.Algorithms.IsValid(pixCount).Not().getInfo() or pixCount.getInfo() is None:
        print("C3: Null after processing")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        c = int(pixCount.getInfo())
        print(f"Active pixels on 2023-10-24: {c}")
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if c > 0 else "<answer>B</answer>")
